about: A line link's place (docs/dev/pdf_citations.md 'Line links'): `?page=<id>&line=N` or `&line=N-M`, N and M of one to eight ASCII digits, 1 <= N <= M <= max_line, and a quote of at most max_quote characters (the first line's verbatim text; an empty one is the number alone). line is the raw value of `line`, quote_chars the length of the quote sent with it; parsed is [N, M or null], or null for a link refused. Read by backend/tests/test_shared_fixtures.py (mcp_links.line_span and MAX_QUOTE, what read_gamma_link takes) and frontend/tests/gammaLinks.test.mjs (parseGammaLink, what the notes and the chat draw as a line pill).

cases.name: the last line a link names
nine digits, though the number is small
a range past the last line
a range that ends before it starts
a long code line as its quote
